description: Figure 2 is a bar chart that compares the average accuracy of different training methods across 11 datasets. The x-axis represents the various training methods, while the y-axis shows the average accuracy. The chart displays the performance of models trained with different methods, including Self-RAG, FactTune, and CINGS, with CINGS showing the highest average accuracy, followed by CINGS (w/ CONTEXT SUP.), and then Self-RAG. The bar for CINGS is the tallest, indicating it has the highest average accuracy, while the bar for Self-RAG is the shortest, indicating the lowest average accuracy among the methods shown. The chart visually emphasizes the superior performance of CINGS in enhancing grounding ability.
